{{Quote|For the bargain hunter Lola Curich Starport has many delights.|An excerpt from the publication's section on Lola Curich|<ref name="MTL" />}}
'''''How to Do the Allied Tion on 25 Credits a Day''''' was a travel guide that gave advice on how to travel within the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] while spending only twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. Available following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the guide included a section on the [[Lola Curich Starport|starport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]], which was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. In that section, the publication described and praised the [[Liann]]s' use of preservatives and [[Spice/Legends|spices]] in cooking, mentioning how they were used in combination with less interesting [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]]. It suggested that travelers buy food on the streets of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], where they could eat for only five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and still fully sample the local cuisine. Foods suggested by the travel guide included [[fish stick]]s, [[Vegeparsine|VegeParsine]], [[choya bread]], and [[Dalkash ale]].<ref name="MTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
''How to Do the Allied Tion on 25 Credits a Day'' first appeared in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', an adventure written by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]] and released in [[1992]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, an excerpt from the guide is used as one of several in-universe introductions to Lianna for the players.<ref name="MTL" />
